patches.name: 0001-adreno-vulkan-pipeline-fixes.patch
patches.purpose: Clamp WG size to 1024 limit, bypass redundant requiredSubgroupSize=64 on Adreno, use SHMEM FP16 reduction.

patches.name: 0002-fix-sd-cli-hardware-gpu-args.patch
